source: RoPE applies a position-dependent rotation to queries and keys. In ordinary attention that is exactly what we want: query-key compatibility depends on relative position through the rotations. But a position-dependent operator inserted between linear projections changes the algebra available to ZXNAME0000XZ.ZXMATH0000XZ
zh: RoPE 对查询和密钥应用位置相关的轮换。在普通注意力中，这正是我们想要的：查询键兼容性取决于通过旋转的相对位置。但是在线性投影之间插入的位置相关运算符会更改 ZXNAME0000XZ.ZXMATH0000XZ 可用的代数
